description: A declined deal — durable context, but must not reserve a date.

input.subject: Re: Paid collaboration inquiry
input.body:
Hi Wei,

Thanks for following up. I'm going to pass on this one — $450 is well below my rate card for a dedicated integration, and the timeline is tighter than I can take on right now.

Happy to revisit if the campaign budget changes later in the year.

Best

rubric:
Good output:
- One commitment with kind "deal_declined"
- exclusive is false (a decline must never block a calendar window)
- start_date and end_date are null; date_precision "none"
- statement makes clear the offer was declined and why (below rate card)
- quote is a verbatim substring

Bad output:
- kind "deal_accepted" (inverts the meaning)
- exclusive true, or any date range attached
- Empty array (the decline is worth remembering)
